property_summary: After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ is equal to its previous value before the call.
After any sequence of public calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter _BASE_RESERVE_() is unchanged.
After any sequence of public calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter _BASE_RESERVE_() is unchanged.
After any sequence of public calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, balanceOf(this) at the end is at least as large as the recorded _BASE_RESERVE_ and _MT_FEE_BASE_ sum.
After any sequence of public calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter _BASE_RESERVE_() returns the same value as before the adjustMtFeeRate call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ state variable remains unchanged (equal to the internal base balance, minus mt fee base).
After adjusting the mt fee rate, the quote reserve equals the quote balance minus the mt fee quote.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ state variable remains unchanged (equal to the internal base balance, minus mt fee base).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ must equal the balance of _BASE_TOKEN_ minus _MT_FEE_BASE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ state variable remains unchanged (equal to the internal quote balance minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_).

The quote reserve _QUOTE_RESERVE_ must eventually update to the actual quote balance after a call to adjustMtFeeRate which sets the mt fee to zero when no fees have been accumulated and the quote balance may have changed due to a prior mint/sell operation.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve must equal the current quote balance of the contract minus the MT fee quote.

After adjustMtFeeRate with the same mtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ and the actual quote balance minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_ must differ whenever a prior token transfer to the contract changed the quote balance but _sync was not called.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate with the same mtFeeRate as before, the quote reserve computed from the public getter must equal the current quote balance of the contract minus the MT fee quote, when no external tokens are sent to the contract.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ must equal the actual quote balance minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_ when the contract's base and quote reserves are nonzero and no other modifications occurred.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged from before the call.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve returned by getVaultReserve must be less than or equal to the actual quote token balance of the contract.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, getVaultReserve's quote reserve must be less than or equal to the total quote token balance (excluding pending mt fees).

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter getVaultReserve must return a quote reserve value that is always strictly less than or equal to the actual quote token balance of the contract (excluding mt fees).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, getVaultReserve's quote reserve must equal the actual quote token balance minus the mt fee quote.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ state variable remains unchanged from before the call.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ remains equal to the quote token balance of the contract minus the _MT_FEE_QUOTE_.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ state variable is updated to the current quote token balance of the contract minus the _MT_FEE_QUOTE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve (_QUOTE_RESERVE_) equals the contract's quote token balance minus the accumulated maintenance fee (_MT_FEE_QUOTE_).
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals the contract's quote token balance minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_.
The TWAP cumulative price is monotonically non-decreasing
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ is at least the initial value (monotonic non-decrease).

After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid input, the TWAP cumulative price (_BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_) must be strictly greater than before the call if any non-zero time has elapsed and reserves are non-zero.
After any single call to adjustMtFeeRate, the TWAP cumulative price does not change relative to its value before the call when _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ is false.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate with a non-zero mtFeeRate, the difference between consecutive calls to getMidPrice (or the TWAP cumulative price) must be proportional to elapsed time when _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ is true.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the price cumulative should be >= the old value.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the cumulative price should change (increase with high probability) when time elapses and reserves are nonzero.

The TWAP cumulative price should increase (or stay same) when block timestamp advances and reserves are nonzero; the reference uses addition, the bug uses subtraction, so the reference's cumulative is non-decreasing.

For any sequence of calls that triggers a TWAP update, the cumulative price from the second update onward should be at least as large as the cumulative price from the first update when the reference uses addition, but the mutant uses subtraction so it can decrease.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the cumulative price should be at least the cumulative price before the call, because the reference adds non-negative contributions and never decreases.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the TWAP cumulative price should remain unchanged.
The TWAP cumulative price should only be updated when the reserves are non-zero and time has elapsed, not during a call that does not modify reserves.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the cumulative TWAP price should remain unchanged because it does not modify reserves or trigger a TWAP update.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, if _RState_ is ONE and reserves are non-zero, the TWAP cumulative price should remain unchanged because adjustMtFeeRate does not modify reserves.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the TWAP cumulative price (_BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_) should remain unchanged, regardless of the initial state of the contract.

The cumulative price variable _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must not be set to a constant 1; it must remain unchanged when adjustMtFeeRate is called (since no state transitions occur that would trigger _twapUpdate).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the cumulative price must remain unchanged (i.e., it must equal its previous value) since no swap or price update occurs.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must remain unchanged (equal to its value before the call).
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must not equal 1.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the liquidity state (reserves, targets, fee accumulators) remains unchanged, and the cumulative price variable _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ remains unchanged (equal to its initial value) because _twapUpdate is never triggered.
When a call to adjustMtFeeRate does not modify the cumulative price, the cumulative price remains unchanged.
After any sequence of operations ending with a call to adjustMtFeeRate, reading _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ returns the same value as before the operation.
After adjustMtFeeRate, the TWAP cumulative price always increases if the block timestamp advanced.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the TWAP cumulative price (_BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_) is strictly greater than before the call if the block timestamp has advanced since the last update and reserves are non-zero.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate() when the block timestamp has advanced and reserves are non-zero, the cumulative price (_BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_) must be strictly greater than its value before the call.
When adjustMtFeeRate is called with any positive mtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must not be changed (i.e., its value must remain as before the call).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with an arbitrary non-zero mtFeeRate, the cumulative price accumulator must remain unchanged from its initial value of zero.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the cumulative price must not increase (i.e., it must remain unchanged or decrease) when both reserves are zero and timeElapsed > 0.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the cumulative price must remain unchanged when both base and quote reserves are zero prior to the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must not increase (i.e., must be unchanged or decreased) when both base and quote reserves are zero and timeElapsed > 0.
